description: Machine-readable target-specific runtime evidence checklist. It is a gap inventory, not hardware evidence.

requirements.name: technical target provenance (EV-000A + EV-000B)
requirements.missing: Both the full target metadata consistency proof (EV-000A) and one-session provenance for all artifacts used together (EV-000B) are required. Physical-device identity is tracked separately by EV-000C and is not a first-bring-up prerequisite.
closure_conditions: no conflicting proven target or session facts exist
SHA-256 equality is treated only as local byte integrity, not device authenticity

requirements.name: target metadata consistency
requirements.missing: All six target metadata fields now match and are explicitly recorded as proven from the exact 21U580 package profile, including the SHA-384-verified kernelcache Mach-O architecture. The envelope validator retains EV-000A as LIKELY because the pre-existing IPS export's source attribution remains UNKNOWN; this does not negate the static package match, authenticate the IPS source, establish physical identity, or close EV-000B.
closure_conditions: model, SoC, watchOS version, and build match the fixed project target with explicit proven sources
board N131bAP is recorded only when independently available and is never inferred from Watch4,2 without an explicit trusted mapping rule
architecture is recorded only from an applicable target-bound source; watchOS process cpuType ARM64_32 is not treated as the DreyzeOS loader architecture
conflicting proven target facts block this requirement

requirements.name: same-session artifact provenance
requirements.missing: No complete capture session currently binds the DreyzeOS image, descriptor, MMU snapshot, and any other evidence consumed together.
closure_conditions: capture_id and bounded UTC start/end are present and proven
producer and source/interface provenance are present and proven
all required and covered artifacts exist and local SHA-256 checks pass
coverage is explicitly complete for the artifacts used
each required/covered artifact has a proven relationship to the same capture_id
conflicting proven session/source declarations block this requirement

requirements.name: physical identity and cross-session continuity
requirements.missing: No persistent physical-device identity attestation exists. CrashReporter Key correlation may only support pseudonymous report correlation and is not serial-level identity or authenticity.
closure_conditions: an independent source explicitly attests persistent physical-device identity or continuity across sessions
private identifiers remain local and are never committed
an old v1 identity_proven claim is not silently migrated to this requirement

requirements.name: loader transfer protocol
requirements.missing: A target-specific, non-persistent handoff protocol defining how bytes, descriptor, PC, EL1, SP, and normalized CPU state reach DreyzeOS.
closure_conditions: no exploit or delivery execution is required by this checklist

requirements.name: runtime DRAM base and size
requirements.missing: Runtime-authoritative DRAM base and size with provenance RUNTIME_VERIFIED; static /memory base=0,size=0 does not close this.
closure_conditions: base and non-zero size are present and proven

requirements.name: payload physical placement
requirements.missing: A target-specific payload PA and bounded size, tied to the verified runtime DRAM interval.
closure_conditions: interval is inside verified runtime RAM

requirements.name: payload alignment and maximum size
requirements.missing: The target-specific copy/alignment limits and an explicit maximum payload size for the future handoff.
closure_conditions: both are checked against the actual image

requirements.name: payload virtual address and entry PC
requirements.missing: A proven executable VA and entry PC for the fixed non-PIC image under the same translation regime.
closure_conditions: entry is inside the payload interval

requirements.name: entry EL1
requirements.missing: Target-specific proof that control arrives at EL1; entry.S is not a universal EL detector.

requirements.name: initial stack and SP
requirements.missing: A proven writable/readable stack interval and 16-byte-aligned incoming SP with ownership and collision evidence.
closure_conditions: stack is owned and disjoint from protected ranges

requirements.name: DAIF normalization
requirements.missing: A proven normalized DAIF state at entry; current source only applies its own EL1 entry policy.
closure_conditions: interrupt behavior is not inferred from absence of evidence

requirements.name: translation regime and MMU registers
requirements.missing: Consistent proven SCTLR_EL1, TCR_EL1, TTBR0_EL1, TTBR1_EL1, and MAIR_EL1 values plus a normalized translation policy.

requirements.name: I-cache, D-cache, vector and FP/SIMD state
requirements.missing: A target-specific normalization/proof record for I-cache, D-cache, VBAR, and FP/SIMD policy.
closure_conditions: VBAR and FP/SIMD state are bounded

requirements.name: stage-0 and kernel executable mappings
requirements.missing: Complete table bytes and register state proving stage-0/entry/text mappings are readable and executable at the intended VA.
closure_conditions: every descriptor page used by the walk is complete
entry and kernel intervals are fully mapped

requirements.name: writable kernel data, BSS and stack mappings
requirements.missing: Complete readable/writable mappings for DreyzeOS data/BSS and stack intervals.
closure_conditions: stack/data ranges are owned and collision-free

requirements.name: descriptor prefix readability and trusted copy
requirements.missing: A bootstrap proof that the fixed 128-byte prefix is readable before descriptor validation and copied to trusted storage.
closure_conditions: nested pointers are not trusted by the prefix alone

requirements.name: boot_args and DeviceTree runtime bounds
requirements.missing: Runtime bounds, complete local bytes, and independent readability proof for boot_args and DeviceTree when used.
closure_conditions: nested pointers stay inside independently proven ranges

requirements.name: UART and AIC virtual mappings
requirements.missing: A supplied translation snapshot showing any virtual mapping for static UART/AIC physical ranges; static PA does not prove VA.
closure_conditions: VA-to-PA translation is proven from a snapshot
access authority remains a separate contract fact

requirements.name: framebuffer reservation and mapping
requirements.missing: Runtime framebuffer PA/size provenance and, if used, its VA mapping and collision status; static /vram is zero-filled.

requirements.name: reserved memory completeness
requirements.missing: A complete list of protected loader, metadata, framebuffer, and reserved intervals in both relevant address spaces.

requirements.name: payload collision audit
requirements.missing: An exhaustive physical and virtual collision result for payload, loader, descriptor, boot metadata, framebuffer, stack, and reserved ranges.

requirements.name: payload ownership
requirements.missing: Explicit ownership/lifetime proof for the payload interval; mapping alone is insufficient.
closure_conditions: loader will not overwrite it after transfer
ownership interval agrees with payload PA/size

requirements.name: descriptor access authority
requirements.missing: An authority proof that allows the first 128-byte read without trusting the descriptor's own VERIFIED bit.
closure_conditions: raw pointers are never dereferenced automatically

requirements.name: translation-to-payload consistency
requirements.missing: A consistent relation between payload PA, payload VA, entry PC, and the same snapshot's page-table translations.

requirements.name: control-flow transfer proof
requirements.missing: A non-persistent, target-specific proof of how control reaches DreyzeOS _start without an unverified branch primitive.
closure_conditions: entry PC is bounded and agrees with ELF
no hardware execution is implied by offline verification

requirements.name: no persistent storage write
requirements.missing: A future loader record explicitly proving persistent_write_required=false for the actual handoff path.
closure_conditions: no NAND/NOR/flash operation is part of handoff

requirements.name: MMU snapshot target binding
requirements.missing: A snapshot whose internal target metadata agrees with the bundle target; matching a filename is insufficient.
closure_conditions: snapshot remains a local evidence artifact

requirements.name: complete table-byte coverage
requirements.missing: Complete bytes for every physical page-table page used by each required VA walk; partial RAM dumps cannot prove absence or permissions.

requirements.name: runtime boot metadata capture
requirements.missing: A bounded runtime capture of boot_args and DeviceTree with independent completeness and readability evidence if DreyzeOS consumes them.
closure_conditions: nested ranges remain inside independent objects
static ADT placeholders are not used as runtime values

requirements.name: runtime handoff evidence bundle
evidence_sources: all referenced local artifacts and verifier dependency nodes
requirements.missing: One internally consistent bundle containing all critical artifacts, hashes, EV-000A, EV-000B, and the remaining runtime evidence graph.
closure_conditions: bundle integrity is confirmed and technical EV-000 (A+B) closes
all critical artifacts and evidence-graph dependencies are present and proven
the full handoff verifier confirms CPU/MMU consistency, mappings, ranges, and collision completeness
EV-000C is reported separately and is not used as an implicit gate
